accessibilityTrack: F92 is separate from design. New F100 scroll layout is tested with unsuppressed audits; all failure messages and assertions are preserved above. No blanket accessibility sign-off.
initialCorrections: Initial captures exposed a remaining4pt header strip, moved inside the tint and protected by a pixel assertion. Initial UI failures included startup navigation, fast-swipe overshoot, optical glyph bearing and an incorrect system-navigation-bar destination check; measured slow gutter drags, which avoid activating Change finishes, and the actual badge-catalogue heading are used by the final checks. Earlier failed runs retained.
acceptedPlatformStandard: Review36 closes F96/F97: native fitted-sheet inset accepted, large sheets edge-attached.

carryOverEvidence.browser36: Passed in Review36; no web changes in this delta.

liveAcceptanceRemaining: Real Shopify OAuth/MFA, payment/tax/shipping/stock and email/wallet acceptance.
Physical Safari universal links, APNs, manual VoiceOver and older supported OS acceptance.

proofBoundary: Isolated Claire captures, no real customer or checkout mutation. Native UIKit-presented review renders do not replace shipping AppRoot and optimized Release interaction checks.
